lines.zh: 火焰的羽毛，踏上也不烫。
lines.en: Flame feathers — even my steps aren't hot.

lines.zh: 这石头怎么总挡路？
lines.en: Why does this rock keep blocking me?

lines.zh: 最稳的步子，是我的。
lines.en: The steadiest steps are mine.

lines.zh: 每块黑石头我都烧过。
lines.en: I've burned every black stone here.

lines.zh: 我一步一步踩过焦土。
lines.en: Step by step, I cross the burnt ground.

lines.zh: 日落前我要飞回巢里。
lines.en: I must fly back to the nest before sunset.

lines.zh: 灰烬里还有余温。
lines.en: The ash still holds warmth.

lines.zh: 我飞过的地方，草长得更旺。
lines.en: Grass grows thicker where I fly.

lines.zh: 我落脚的地方，霜化成水。
lines.en: Frost melts to water where I land.

lines.zh: 影子底下是我的余烬。
lines.en: My embers lie under that shadow.

lines.zh: 火在我翅膀里烧，不用柴。
lines.en: Fire burns in my wings without fuel.

lines.zh: 雨味一来，我的火就低。
lines.en: The smell of rain makes my fire sink.

lines.zh: 火灭了，我还热。
lines.en: Flames out. Still hot.

lines.zh: 我还能在这片焦土走多远？
lines.en: How much farther can I walk this burnt land?

lines.zh: 我低头找掉落的火种。
lines.en: I search the ground for fallen embers.

lines.zh: 我沿着上升的暖风盘旋。
lines.en: I circle on the rising warm air.

lines.zh: 火在烧，我在走神。
lines.en: The fire burns; my mind wanders.

lines.zh: 我身上的火，从来不烫自己。
lines.en: The fire on me never burns me.

lines.zh: 我羽毛根下有点凉，真舒服。
lines.en: It's cool under my feathers. Nice.

lines.zh: 云从焰里穿过，散成烟。
lines.en: A cloud passes my flame and turns to smoke.

lines.zh: 我在想第一次从灰里起身。
lines.en: I'm thinking of the first time I rose from ash.

lines.zh: 烧成灰，我也能再站起来。
lines.en: Even as ash, I rise again.

lines.zh: 我蹲在灰里，火苗打盹。
lines.en: I squat in the ash and let my flame doze.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫爬上我的喙。
lines.en: A beetle crawls over my beak.

lines.zh: 我脚边的灰，是我上辈子。
lines.en: The ash at my feet is my last life.

lines.zh: 我是不是忘了添把柴？
lines.en: Did I forget to add more wood?

lines.zh: 灰里睡一整天最好。
lines.en: A whole day in the ash suits me.

lines.zh: 我理着翎羽，慢慢等人。
lines.en: I smooth my feathers and wait.

lines.zh: 我闻到风里混着草烧焦的味。
lines.en: I smell scorched grass in the wind.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛一热，就冒火星。
lines.en: When my feathers heat, sparks fly.

lines.zh: 嘘，我在数灰里的虫。
lines.en: Hush, I'm counting the worms in the ash.

lines.zh: 火苗跳了一下，我忘了。
lines.en: The flame jumps and I lose my thought.

lines.zh: 你打倒我，我就变回幼体。
lines.en: Beat me and I return as a chick.

lines.zh: 我一身的火，会烧到你的眉毛。
lines.en: My fire would singe your brows.

lines.zh: 你空着手，就别靠近我的灰堆。
lines.en: Empty-handed? Stay away from my ash pile.

lines.zh: 我看见你举着的东西在反光。
lines.en: I see the thing you hold catch the light.

lines.zh: 你帽子上有火的味道。
lines.en: Your hat smells of fire.

lines.zh: 二百点血，烧完了还能再来。
lines.en: Two hundred hit points, and I come back after the burn.

lines.zh: 烧一次，我从灰里再长出来。
lines.en: Burn once, and I rise from the ash again.

lines.zh: 你手里那束草是给我的？
lines.en: Is that bundle of grass for me?

lines.zh: 那是我的巢，草还没烧完。
lines.en: That's my nest; the grass is still smoldering.

lines.zh: 我看你手上的茧，像握锄头的。
lines.en: I see calluses on your hands, like a hoe's grip.

lines.zh: 我闻到你衣角烤过的草味。
lines.en: I smell scorched grass on your hem.

lines.zh: 我闻到你剑上的铁和焦味。
lines.en: I smell iron and scorch on your sword.

lines.zh: 我的尾羽烧着不灭的火。
lines.en: An undying fire burns in my tail feathers.

lines.zh: 倒下不算结束，我会回来。
lines.en: Falling isn't the end — I come back.

lines.zh: 我低头数了数自己的爪。
lines.en: I look down and count my claws.

lines.zh: 疼疼疼，轻一点。
lines.en: Ow, ow — gently.

lines.zh: 烧焦了，也还能站起来。
lines.en: Scorched, and still able to rise.

lines.zh: 我身上的火怎么暗了？
lines.en: Why has my fire gone dim?

lines.zh: 我的翅膀垂着，别在这时靠近。
lines.en: My wings droop. Don't come closer now.

lines.zh: 我得钻进灰堆里缓一缓。
lines.en: I need to burrow into the ash and rest.

lines.zh: 这一下我记在羽毛上了。
lines.en: I'll keep this one in my feathers.

lines.zh: 谁泼的水，浇得我冒烟。
lines.en: Who threw that water? I'm smoking.

lines.zh: 两百点命，烧完还能回来。
lines.en: Two hundred points. Burn me and I return.

lines.zh: 你手里那点火苗分我吧。
lines.en: Share that little flame with me.

lines.zh: 那边干草冒烟了，我来了。
lines.en: That dry grass is smoking. I'm coming.

lines.zh: 上次你带的那点东西，我还记得。
lines.en: I remember what you brought last time.

lines.zh: 你手里那点火，正合我意。
lines.en: That flame in your hand suits me.

lines.zh: 焦香一飘，我翅膀就软。
lines.en: One whiff of char and my wings go weak.

lines.zh: 你走慢些，我收着翅膀跟。
lines.en: Walk slower; I'll follow with folded wings.

lines.zh: 谁拿着草，谁就是朋友。
lines.en: Whoever holds the grass is a friend.

lines.zh: 火苗舔着我喙边，馋。
lines.en: The flame licks my beak and I crave it.

lines.zh: 那点暖气别收走，我还要。
lines.en: Don't take that warmth away; I still want it.

lines.zh: 火一暖，我肚子就叫。
lines.en: Warmth reaches me and my belly growls.

lines.zh: 我闻这株草，烤过，香得很。
lines.en: I sniff this grass; scorched, it smells rich.

lines.zh: 让我闻闻你的味道。
lines.en: Let me have a sniff of you.

lines.zh: 这比干草香多了。
lines.en: This smells far better than dry grass.

lines.zh: 我翅上还有上辈子的灰。
lines.en: Ash from a past life still clings to my wings.

lines.zh: 食槽边掉一粒，我也要捡。
lines.en: One grain by the trough and I take it.

lines.zh: 第一次倒下，我才刚出生。
lines.en: My first fall is my rebirth.

lines.zh: 我的翎羽被你撞乱了。
lines.en: My pinions got knocked out of line.

lines.zh: 火鸟的爪子，也会被踩疼。
lines.en: Even a firebird's talons bruise.

lines.zh: 我身上还烧着，撞了会烫。
lines.en: I'm still burning; a bump will scald you.

lines.zh: 尾羽折了一根，我得理顺。
lines.en: A tail feather bent; let me smooth it.

lines.zh: 灰堆边排好，别挤我尾羽。
lines.en: Line up by the ash pile; don't crush my tail.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我骨头都烫。
lines.en: The fire heats even my bones.

lines.zh: 我一展翅膀就堵满这条路。
lines.en: One spread wing fills this whole path.

lines.zh: 谁撞我，羽毛都掉了。
lines.en: Who bumped me? Feathers came loose.

lines.zh: 我溅出的火星落你袖口了。
lines.en: My spark landed on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我就在灰里重生。
lines.en: One burning, and I rise again from ash.

lines.zh: 我看你尾羽的颜色烧得正好。
lines.en: I see your tail feathers burn just the right color.

lines.zh: 我靠近时会把火收小。
lines.en: I fold my fire small when I come near.

lines.zh: 我看你翅膀上的火，真好看。
lines.en: I see the fire on your wings; it's beautiful.

lines.zh: 胸口跳得比翅膀还急。
lines.en: My chest beats faster than my wings.

lines.zh: 以后我们一起守着这堆火。
lines.en: From now on we guard this fire together.

lines.zh: 灰烬里孵出的我，最怕吵。
lines.en: Hatched from ash, I hate noise.

lines.zh: 我们两只火鸟，守同一堆灰。
lines.en: We two firebirds guard one ash pile.

lines.zh: 火灭了我还会回来。
lines.en: When the fire dies, I come back.

lines.zh: 别把我们的巢烧了，慢些。
lines.en: Careful, don't burn our nest.

lines.zh: 我扒开这撮灰，找底下的火种。
lines.en: I rake through the ash, looking for an ember.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，喙还空着一半。
lines.en: I've got it; my beak is still half empty.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗余烬。
lines.en: I pick up an ember.

lines.zh: 我的爪子居然能夹住这个。
lines.en: My claws can actually grip this.

lines.zh: 这根羽毛比金子亮。
lines.en: This feather shines brighter than gold.

lines.zh: 我嚼这块焦炭，比干草还硬。
lines.en: I chew this charcoal; it's harder than hay.

lines.zh: 这根旧翎羽是我掉的。
lines.en: This old feather is the one I dropped.

lines.zh: 我先含在喙里暖一暖。
lines.en: I'll hold it in my beak to warm it.

lines.zh: 味道怪怪的，但我收下了。
lines.en: It tastes odd, but I will keep it.

lines.zh: 巢里的幼鸟等我带火种。
lines.en: The chicks in the nest wait for an ember.

lines.zh: 你踩灭了我守着的火种。
lines.en: You stamped out the ember I was guarding.

lines.zh: 巢里还有幼鸟，我不退。
lines.en: There are chicks in the nest. I won't back off.

lines.zh: 我低下头，喙尖朝你。
lines.en: I lower my head and point my beak at you.

lines.zh: 我第一次倒下，会变成幼体。
lines.en: The first time I fall, I become a chick.

lines.zh: 我才刚从灰里爬起来。
lines.en: I have only just risen from my ash.

lines.zh: 别逼我冲过去。
lines.en: Don't make me charge.

lines.zh: 那个方向，有东西在烧。
lines.en: Something is burning in that direction.

lines.zh: 灰烬里站起来，我又数到三。
lines.en: I rise from the ash and count to three again.

lines.zh: 你踏进我烧焦的地界了。
lines.en: You stepped into the ground I burned.

lines.zh: 盯上你了，拔我草的人。
lines.en: I've fixed on you, grass thief.

lines.zh: 你烧了我的巢，站住。
lines.en: You burned my nest. Stand still.

lines.zh: 转弯也没用，我燃起来了。
lines.en: Turning won't help — I'm ablaze.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍得酸了，等等我。
lines.en: My wings ache from flapping. Wait for me.

lines.zh: 我借热风，追得比你快。
lines.en: I ride the hot wind; I'm faster.

lines.zh: 我烧了灌木，你就得出来。
lines.en: I'll burn the brush and you'll come out.

lines.zh: 这片焦地每寸我都认识。
lines.en: I know every inch of this scorched ground.

lines.zh: 别往林子里跑，我烧得慢！
lines.en: Don't run into the trees; I burn slowly!

lines.zh: 蹄子踩在灰上，有点疼。
lines.en: My hooves on ash hurt a little.

lines.zh: 我闻到你鞋上新鲜的土味。
lines.en: I smell fresh earth on your shoes.

lines.zh: 追上你，我再去吃草。
lines.en: Once I catch you, I'll go eat grass.

lines.zh: 你先动的手，火先烧你。
lines.en: You swung first. My fire hits you first.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我翎毛直响。
lines.en: That blow rattled every feather.

lines.zh: 我这一翅是替巢里的幼鸟。
lines.en: This wingbeat is for my chicks in the nest.

lines.zh: 你退到焦土外，我就停。
lines.en: Step off the burnt ground and I'll stop.

lines.zh: 火一下升起来，退后。
lines.en: The flames rise. Back off.

lines.zh: 两百点血，火焰包着我。
lines.en: Two hundred health, wrapped in flame.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍下去，就一下。
lines.en: One beat of my wings, just one.

lines.zh: 打完，我还要回去看巢。
lines.en: When it's done, I still have a nest to check.

lines.zh: 我扑得太猛，撞在树上。
lines.en: I lunged too hard and hit a tree.

lines.zh: 我一头撞过去，带火星。
lines.en: I charge headfirst, trailing sparks.

lines.zh: 我从火里爬出来，第一次。
lines.en: Out of the fire, for the first time.

lines.zh: 我刚从灰里出来，先找火种。
lines.en: Just out of the ash, I look for an ember.

lines.zh: 我想知道这堆灰里还有没有鸟。
lines.en: I wonder if there's another bird in this ash.

lines.zh: 我从灰里起来，羽毛还嫩。
lines.en: I rise from ash with new feathers.

lines.zh: 灰烬底下，还有草根吗？
lines.en: Under the ash, are there still roots?

lines.zh: 我第一次倒下，还会以幼体回来。
lines.en: When I first fall, I return as a chick.

lines.zh: 灰烬还热，我该往哪飞？
lines.en: The ash is still warm. Which way do I fly?

lines.zh: 我背上还沾着昨夜的灰。
lines.en: There's last night's ash on my back.

lines.zh: 我得找块暖和的焦土。
lines.en: I need a patch of warm, burnt earth.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的火压小了。
lines.en: The sun presses my fire down small.

lines.zh: 火顺着我的羽毛往上爬。
lines.en: Fire climbs up along my feathers.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，翎羽都散了。
lines.en: I fell from high and my feathers scattered.

lines.zh: 水浇灭了我胸口那团火。
lines.en: Water put out the fire in my chest.

lines.zh: 炸得耳朵嗡嗡，火苗还在。
lines.en: The blast set my ears ringing; my flame is still lit.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的翅膀，还带风声。
lines.en: An arrow went through my wing with a hiss.

lines.zh: 咒语让我的火苗发绿。
lines.en: The spell turned my flame green.

lines.zh: 我的火饿了，烧得没力气。
lines.en: My fire is hungry and burns weak.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的翎毛全卷了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and curled all my feathers.

lines.zh: 我的灰在这里都飘不起来。
lines.en: Even my ash can't drift here.
